CHARACTER_FORGE.ButtonHint: Open the Character Forge creation wizard.

Identity.Desc: Let's start with the basics of who your character is.
Identity.Name: Name
Identity.NameHint: Your character's name. You can change it later on the actor sheet.
Identity.AlignmentHint: Alignment describes how your character relates to law and chaos, good and evil. Skip if you'd rather decide through play.
Identity.PortraitHint: Path to an image file inside your Foundry data. You can set or change this later on the actor sheet.

PackPicker.Title: Content Sources
PackPicker.Help: The wizard pulls race / class / background / spell / feat / item cards from every Foundry compendium pack listed here. Uncheck the ones you don't want to see in the wizard — typically used to hide duplicate "Classes (SRD)" and "Classes (2024)" packs, or to scope Plutonium imports to a specific source book.

Welcome.Title: Welcome to Character Forge
Welcome.Heading: Welcome to Character Forge
Welcome.Sub: A friendlier way to create and level up D&D 5e characters.
Welcome.WhatBullet1: Guides players through creating a level-1 Player Character with cards and explanations, not raw item drag-and-drop.
Welcome.WhatBullet2: Wraps the D&D 5e native Advancement Manager with a friendly entry point on every character sheet (the ↑ icon).
Welcome.WhatBullet3: Supports multiclass via a level-up dialog that shows PHB ability prerequisites.
Welcome.ContentSrd: The 9 SRD races, 6 SRD backgrounds, and (currently) one bundled SRD class are CC-BY-4.0 content shipped inside this module. They work out of the box.
Welcome.ContentBeyond: Everything else — Tasha's races, Xanathar's classes, Mordenkainen's feats — comes from compendium packs you've installed in Foundry. The easiest way to populate those is the Plutonium module, which imports content from 5e.tools. You only run it once per world.
Welcome.Dismiss: Got it — don't show this again

LevelUp.NoAdvancement: {name} was built from SRD-bundled data and has no advancement chain — the level was raised, but HP and class features won't update automatically. Consider using a compendium-sourced class for full level-up support.
LevelUp.Title: Level Up
LevelUp.ButtonHint: Level up this character via Character Forge
LevelUp.Help: Pick a path. Either raise the level of a class you already have, or take a level 1 dip into a new class (multiclass).
LevelUp.MulticlassHelp: PHB 2014 multiclass rules require you to meet an ability-score prerequisite for both your current class and the new one. Cards that don't meet the prereq are dimmed but still selectable — your table can choose to ignore the rule.
LevelUp.NoMulticlassOptions: No other classes available — multiclass is disabled in settings, or you already have a level in every registered class.
LevelUp.NoSelection: Pick a class above to continue.
LevelUp.Triggered: Advancement Manager opened — make your choices to finish leveling up.
LevelUp.Error: Level-up failed. Check the browser console for details.

Equipment.Desc: Pick your starting equipment from the options offered by the {class} class. Background items and starting gold are added automatically.
Equipment.Note: This step is shown only for SRD-bundled classes that ship parsed equipment choices. Compendium-sourced classes get their starting gear via D&D 5e's native Starting Equipment advancement when the class is added.

Review.Desc: One last look before forging. Click any earlier step in the progress bar above to make changes.
Review.AdvancementTip: When you click Forge Character, the D&D 5e Advancement Manager will walk you through any choices defined by your race, class, and background (skill picks, fighting style, hit-point roll, etc.). Equipment from compendium classes is handled on the character sheet's Starting Equipment tab.

Background.Desc: Pick your character's background. The background grants two skill proficiencies, often tool proficiencies or languages, a non-mechanical feature, and a small amount of starting gold and gear.
Background.SelectPrompt: Select a background above to see its full details.
Background.SrdNote: This background was built from Character Forge's bundled SRD data. For automatic skill / tool / feature grants, use the dnd5e system's background compendiums or import via Plutonium.
Background.CompendiumNoSnippet: No preview text available for this background. Selecting it will use the version stored in the compendium.
Background.CompendiumNote: This background comes from an installed compendium. Skill / tool / feature grants will be applied by D&D 5e's native advancement system when the character is forged.

Class.Desc: Pick your character's class. The class determines your hit die, saving-throw proficiencies, primary ability, and the features you gain at each level. Subclass selection happens automatically when you reach the appropriate level.
Class.SelectPrompt: Select a class above to see its full details.
Class.SkillsChoiceText: Pick {choose} from the class skill list (handled in the Skills step).
Class.SrdNote: This class was built from Character Forge's bundled SRD data. For automatic feature grants and the dnd5e Advancement walkthrough, use the dnd5e system's class compendiums or import via Plutonium.
Class.CompendiumNoSnippet: No preview text available for this class. Selecting it will use the version stored in the compendium.
Class.CompendiumNote: This class comes from an installed compendium. Skills, fighting style, hit points, and feature grants will be applied by D&D 5e's native advancement system when the character is forged.

Race.Desc: Pick your character's race. Each race grants ability score bonuses, traits, and a starting size & speed. Some races have subraces with extra options.
Race.SelectPrompt: Select a race above to see its full details.
Race.CompendiumNoSnippet: No preview text available for this race. Selecting it will use the version stored in the compendium.
Race.CompendiumNote: This race comes from an installed compendium. Ability score increases, traits, and proficiencies will be applied by D&D 5e's native advancement system when the character is forged.

Abilities.Desc: Choose how to set your ability scores. You can swap methods at any time — switching resets your scores so nothing leaks between methods.

PointBuy.Title: Point-buy (27 points, scores 8–15)
PointBuy.Help: Spend a budget of 27 points to raise each ability from 8. Scores 9–13 cost 1 point each; 14 and 15 cost an extra point each (so 14 = 7 pts, 15 = 9 pts).

StandardArray.Title: Standard array (15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8)
StandardArray.Help: Assign each of the six fixed numbers to one ability. Every value is used exactly once.

Roll.Title: Roll 4d6, drop lowest
Roll.Help: Roll four six-sided dice for each ability and keep the highest three. Then drag the results into the abilities of your choice — each rolled value is used exactly once.
Roll.PromptRoll: Click Roll to generate six values.

CHARACTER_FORGE.ResetConfirmContent: This will discard everything you've entered so far. Are you sure?

Settings.DefaultAbilityMethodHint: Which method to preselect on the Ability Scores step.
Settings.AllowMulticlassHint: Enable the multiclass option in the Level Up wizard.
Settings.AllowFeatAtLevel1Hint: Per the optional rule in the PHB, characters gain one feat at character creation.
Settings.ImportedOverridesSrdHint: When an imported entry has the same key as an SRD entry, prefer the imported one.
Settings.AutoTickXpHint: Award XP to the actor automatically when the Level Up wizard completes.

Notify.NoName: Please enter a character name before continuing.
Notify.NoRace: Please choose a race before continuing.
Notify.NoSubrace: This race has subraces — please pick one before continuing.
Notify.NoClass: Please choose a class before continuing.
Notify.NoBackground: Please choose a background before continuing.
Notify.AbilitiesOverBudget: Point-buy total exceeds 27 points. Lower some scores before continuing.
Notify.AbilitiesOutOfRange: Each point-buy score must be between 8 and 15.
Notify.AbilitiesUnassigned: Assign a value to every ability before continuing.
Notify.AbilitiesNotStandardArray: Standard array requires each of 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, and 8 to be used exactly once.
Notify.AbilitiesNotRolled: Click Roll to generate six values, then assign them to your abilities.
Notify.AbilitiesAssignmentMismatch: Each rolled value must be assigned to exactly one ability.
Notify.HpFallbackSrd: {name} was built from SRD data (no advancement chain). Set max HP to {hp} (hit die + CON mod). Edit on the sheet if you'd prefer to roll.
Notify.HpFallbackAdvancement: {name}'s level-up wasn't completed, so max HP was set to {hp} as a safety fallback. Use the level-up button on the sheet to redo it if you want to roll HP properly.
Notify.HpFallbackNoClass: Cannot set HP — this actor has no class item. Use Forge Character to add one.
Notify.DraftPending: Character Forge: a saved draft is available. Open the wizard to resume.
Notify.ForgeSuccess: Forged {name}. Continue to assign abilities, class, and equipment on the sheet.
Notify.ForgeError: Character Forge: something went wrong while creating the character. Check the browser console for details.
Notify.SrdRaceNote: This race was built from Character Forge's bundled SRD data. For automatic ASI / trait application, install Plutonium or use the dnd5e system's race compendiums.
Notify.WrongSystem: Character Forge requires the D&D 5e system.
Notify.OldSystem: Character Forge requires D&D 5e {required}+. Detected version: {current}. Some features may not work.
Notify.SrdLoadError: Character Forge: failed to load the bundled SRD data. The wizard will not work until this is fixed.

Human.name: Human
Human.desc: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races.

Barbarian.name: Barbarian
Barbarian.desc: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.desc: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

Cleric.name: Cleric
Cleric.desc: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

Druid.name: Druid
Druid.desc: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature.

Fighter.name: Fighter
Fighter.desc: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

Monk.name: Monk
Monk.desc: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.

Paladin.name: Paladin
Paladin.desc: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath.

Ranger.name: Ranger
Ranger.desc: A warrior who combats threats on the edges of civilization.

Rogue.name: Rogue
Rogue.desc: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles.

Sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
Sorcerer.desc: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

Warlock.name: Warlock
Warlock.desc: A wielder of magic that is derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity.

Wizard.name: Wizard
Wizard.desc: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality.

Berserker.name: Path of the Berserker
Berserker.desc: Frenzied combat at the cost of personal exhaustion.

Lore.name: College of Lore
Lore.desc: Bards who collect spells and secrets from far and wide.

LifeDomain.name: Life Domain
LifeDomain.desc: The vitality that sustains all living things.

CircleOfTheLand.name: Circle of the Land
CircleOfTheLand.desc: Druids who meet within sacred circles to trade knowledge.

Champion.name: Champion
Champion.desc: Focused on the physical perfection of body and weapon mastery.

OpenHand.name: Way of the Open Hand
OpenHand.desc: Monks who specialize in unarmed combat.

Devotion.name: Oath of Devotion
Devotion.desc: The paladin's commitment to the highest ideals of justice, virtue, and order.

Thief.name: Thief
Thief.desc: Stealthy rogues who specialize in sleight of hand and second-story work.

Draconic.name: Draconic Bloodline
Draconic.desc: Sorcerers whose innate magic comes from draconic ancestry.

Fiend.name: The Fiend
Fiend.desc: A warlock who has made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes.

Evocation.name: School of Evocation
Evocation.desc: Wizards who specialize in spells that create powerful elemental effects.

Acolyte.name: Acolyte
Acolyte.desc: You have spent your life in the service of a temple to a specific god or pantheon of gods.

Criminal.name: Criminal
Criminal.desc: You are an experienced criminal with a history of breaking the law.

FolkHero.name: Folk Hero
FolkHero.desc: You come from a humble social rank, but you are destined for so much more.

Noble.name: Noble
Noble.desc: You understand wealth, power, and privilege.

Sage.name: Sage
Sage.desc: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse.

Soldier.name: Soldier
Soldier.desc: War has been your life for as long as you care to remember.
